item.title: Safey underlies Freeland school renovation plans
item.description: FREELAND — “Safety is a driving factor” for renovations at Freeland Elementary/Middle School, a designer of the plans said. James Keifer of KCBA Architects said the plans provide separate driving routes for buses and parents and redesign the main entrance. “It allows people in the building when they need to be. item.title: PIAA CLASS 3A WRESTLING: Schechterly, Benyos advance to quarters
item.description: HERSHEY — West Scranton’s Tommy Schechterly and Hazleton Area’s Jake and Gabe Benyo had their eyes on the quarterfinals. The sophomore wrestlers all achieved that goal in different ways. For Schechterly, it was about getting that first takedown and securing early control of the match. For Jake Benyo, it was about getting in position to build the lead with tilts. For Gabe Benyo, it was about doing just enough to stay in the hunt for gold. item.title: March for Michael fundraiser underway in Freeland
item.description: St. Michael’s Lanes has announced that the March for Michael fundraiser in memory of Michael Detweiler will be held again this year.
